title: Crosstalk between aryl hydrocarbon receptor and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway: Possible culprit of di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate-mediated cardiotoxicity in zebrafish larvae.
authors: Yang, Yang; Tao, Yue; Yi, Xiaodong; Zhong, Guanyu; Gu, Yanyan; Cui, Yunhe; Zhang, Ying
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DEHP通过AhR与Wnt/β-catenin信号通路串扰致斑马鱼心脏毒性，仅用分子对接初探配体-受体结合，核心为毒理学表型与通路验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Typical plasticizer di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) has been demonstrated to induce cardiotoxicity in zebrafish, but the potential molecular mechanisms involved have not been fully elucidated. Aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), an essential protein for inducing developmental abnormalities, has been demonstrated to be activated by DEHP in other species, but whether the AhR signaling pathway also contributes to DEHP-mediated cardiac developmental toxicity in zebrafish remains unclear. Firstly, molecular docking simulations initially confirmed the possibility that DEHP has AhR agonistic activity. To further confirm this conjecture, this work analyzed the changes of cardiac-related indexes in zebrafish stressed by DEHP at individual, protein, and gene levels. The results showed that DEHP mediated cardiac phenotypic developmental defects, increased CYP1A1 activity, and oxidative stress as well as significant changes in the expression levels of key proteins and genes of AhR, Wnt/beta-catenin, and Nrf2-Keap1 signaling pathways. Notably, the addition of AhR inhibitors effectively alleviated the above negative effects, indicating that the AhR signaling pathway and its crosstalk with the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway is an essential pathway for DEHP-mediated cardiac developmental toxicity. Overall, this work enriches the molecular mechanism of DEHP-mediated cardiac developmental defects in zebrafish and provides a reliable biomarker for future environmental risk assessment of DEHP.
abstract_zh: 典型增塑剂邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）已被证明可诱导斑马鱼心脏毒性，但涉及的潜在分子机制尚未完全阐明。芳烃受体（AhR）作为诱导发育异常的关键蛋白，在其他物种中已被证明可被DEHP激活，但AhR信号通路是否也参与DEHP介导的斑马鱼心脏发育毒性仍不清楚。首先，分子对接模拟初步确认了DEHP具有AhR激动活性的可能性。为进一步验证这一推测，本研究在个体、蛋白质和基因水平上分析了DEHP胁迫下斑马鱼心脏相关指标的变化。结果表明，DEHP介导了心脏表型发育缺陷，增加了CYP1A1活性及氧化应激，并显著改变了AhR、Wnt/β-catenin和Nrf2-Keap1信号通路中关键蛋白质和基因的表达水平。值得注意的是，添加AhR抑制剂有效缓解了上述负面效应，表明AhR信号通路及其与Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的串扰是DEHP介导心脏发育毒性的关键途径。总体而言，本研究丰富了DEHP介导斑马鱼心脏发育缺陷的分子机制，并为未来DEHP环境风险评估提供了可靠的生物标志物。
